arxiv-2002-00116.creator: Jeremy E. Kozdon, Brittany A. Erickson, Lucas C. Wilcox
arxiv-2002-00116.description: Abstract We present a hybridization technique for summation-by-parts finite difference methods with weak enforcement of interface and boundary conditions for second order, linear elliptic partial differential equations. The method is based on techniques from the hybridized discontinuous Galerkin literature where local and global problems are defined for the volume and trace grid points, respectively.

arxiv-2102-05770.title: Current-limiting amplifier for high speed measurement of resistive switching data
arxiv-2102-05770.creator: T. Hennen, E. Wichmann, A. Elias, J. Lille, O. Mosendz, R. Waser, D. J. Wouters, D. Bedau
arxiv-2102-05770.description: Abstract Resistive switching devices, important for emerging memory and neuromorphic applications, face significant challenges related to control of delicate filamentary states in the oxide material. As a device switches, its rapid conductivity change is involved in a positive feedback process that would lead to runaway destruction of the cell without current, voltage, or energy limitation.

Weisskopf, Luca Baldini, Victor Doroshenko, Steven R. Ehlert, Jeremy Heyl, Philip Kaaret, Dawoon E. Kim, Frédéric Marin,
arxiv-2410-20582.description: Abstract Synchrotron X-ray emission has been detected from nearly a dozen young supernova remnants (SNRs). X-rays of synchrotron origin exhibit linear polarization in a regular, non-randomly oriented magnetic field. The significant polarized X-ray emission from four such SNRs has already been reported on the basis of observations with the Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer (IXPE).

arxiv-2411-14294.title: Enhanced Collisional Losses from a Magnetic Mirror Using the Lenard-Bernstein Collision Operator
arxiv-2411-14294.creator: Maxwell H. Rosen \aff 1 \corresp, W. Sengupta \aff 1, I. Ochs \aff 1, F. I. Parra \aff 1,2, G. W. Hammett \aff 2
arxiv-2411-14294.description: Abstract Collisions are crucial in governing particle and energy transport in plasmas confined in a magnetic mirror trap. Modern gyrokinetic codes model transport in magnetic mirrors, but some utilize approximate model collision operators. This study focuses on a Pastukhov-style method of images calculation of particle and energy confinement times using a Lenard-Bernstein model collision operator.

arxiv-2509-16870.creator: Rui Yang, Michael Fu, Chakkrit Tantithamthavorn, Chetan Arora, Gunel Gulmammadova, Joey Chua
arxiv-2509-16870.description: Abstract Intelligent software systems powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in critical sectors, raising concerns about their safety during runtime. Through an industry-academic collaboration when deploying an LLM-powered virtual customer assistant, a critical software engineering challenge emerged: how to enhance a safer deployment of LLM-powered software systems at runtime?

arxiv-2511-00687.title: Electromagnetic deflection effects in the integrated luminosity measurement at the CEPC

arxiv-2511-00687.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ivan Smiljanić, Ivanka Božović, Ivana Vidaković, Nataša Vukašinović, Goran Kačarević. In order to ensure measurement of the integrated luminosity with a relative precision of 10 − 4 \mathrm{10^{-4}} at the Z 0 \mathrm{Z^{0}} pole at CEPC, numerous systematic effects have to be quantified and, if possible, corrected for. Here we discuss the impact of electromagnetic fields of incoming bunches on the initial state electrons and positrons (EMD1) as well as on the Bhabha scattering final states (EMD2).

britannica-1911-pendleside-series.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-pendleside-series.description: Article 'Pendleside Series' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 21), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. the upper division of the Carboniferous Limestone and the Millstone Grits occurring in the Midlands between Stoke-on-Trent and Settle. It consists of black limestones at the base, followed by black shales with calcareous nodules, which pass into sandy shales with ganister-like sandstones. In places the series attains a thickness of 1500–1000 ft., and where it is thickest the Millstone Grits also attain their maximum thickness.

pmc-10659666.description: Background:Extracorporeal shockwave therapy (ESWT) has been widely used for various musculoskeletal disorders, including knee osteoarthritis (OA), and has been shown in several studies to be a safe treatment. Although some studies have confirmed the pain-relieving effect of ESWT for knee OA, research on objectivity for structural changes in knee OA is lacking.

pmc-11394788.creator: Qiyuan Han, Jenna Fernandez, Andrew T Rajczewski, Thomas J Y Kono, Nicholas A Weirath, Abdur Rahim, Alexander S Lee, Donna Seabloom, Natalia Y Tretyakova, Apostolos Zaravinos
pmc-11394788.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Lung cancer remains a major contributor to cancer fatalities, with cigarette smoking known to be responsible for up to 80% of cases. Based on the ability of cigarette smoke to induce inflammation in the lungs and increased lung cancer incidence in smokers with inflammatory conditions such as COPD, we hypothesized that inflammation plays an important role in the carcinogenicity of cigarette smoke.

pmc-11462924.title: Effect of sequencing platforms on the sensitivity of chemical mutation detection using Hawk-Seq™
pmc-11462924.creator: Sayaka Hosoi, Takako Hirose, Shoji Matsumura, Yuki Otsubo, Kazutoshi Saito, Masaaki Miyazawa, Takayoshi Suzuki, Kenichi Masumura, Kei-ichi Sugiyama
pmc-11462924.description: BackgroundError-corrected next-generation sequencing (ecNGS) technologies have enabled the direct evaluation of genome-wide mutations after exposure to mutagens. Previously, we reported an ecNGS methodology, Hawk-Seq™, and demonstrated its utility in evaluating mutagenicity. The evaluation of technical transferability is essential to further evaluate the reliability of ecNGS-based assays. However, cutting-edge sequencing platforms are continually evolving, which can affect the sensitivity of ecNGS.

pmc-12733227.creator: Jie Wang, Zong Jie Cui, Anastasios Lymperopoulos
pmc-12733227.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Cholecystokinin 1 receptor (CCK1R) is activated by singlet oxygen (1O2) in type II photodynamic action in isolated rat, mouse, and Peking duck pancreatic acini. To examine whether this is maintained outside the microenvironment of pancreatic acinar cell, photodynamic activation of CCK1R from human, rat, mouse, and Peking duck expressed in CHO-K1 cells was examined, as monitored with Fura-2 fluorescence calcium imaging.

pmc-13236882.title: Mapping healthcare service utilisation for diabetes and hypertension in Tanzania mainland: bayesian spatial modeling
pmc-13236882.creator: Elia Magwaja, Jim Todd, Ladislaus Chang’a, Anthony Kapesa, Eustasius Musenge, George PrayGod, Brenda Kitilya, Eliud Kamala, Eliakimu Kapyolo, Daniel Faurholt-Jepsen, Zvifadzo Matsena Zingoni
pmc-13236882.description: Diabetes and hypertension pose a growing non-communicable disease (NCD) burden in sub-Saharan Africa. However, in most countries, healthcare service provision remains uneven and there are no comprehensive methods for monitoring service use. We mapped and modeled district-level patient healthcare service utilisation for diabetes and hypertension in mainland Tanzania to identify spatial patterns and socio-demographic correlates using Bayesian spatial models.

pmc-13674170.title: Normal thromboelastography with a markedly prolonged activated partial thromboplastin time in severe prekallikrein deficiency: Implications for perioperative hemostatic assessment
pmc-13674170.creator: Jeremy W Jacobs, Anton Matafonov, Patricia G Baxter, Qiufang Cheng, Garrett S Booth, Deva Sharma, Benjamin F Tillman, David Gailani
pmc-13674170.description: BackgroundPrekallikrein (PK) deficiency is a rare contact factor deficiency that can markedly prolong the activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) without a bleeding phenotype. Because viscoelastic hemostatic assays also rely on contact activation, their behavior in severe PK deficiency is relevant to perioperative evaluation of isolated aPTT prolongation. We describe thromboelastography (TEG) 6s findings in a patient with severe PK deficiency.
